Pure HTML / CSS Implementation

Copy and paste this standard 6-slot gallery strip directly into your layout or template. 

<!-- HTMX PRO 6-Slot Gallery Strip -->
<div class="border-2 border-dashed border-border/80 rounded-xl p-3 bg-muted/20">
  <div class="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-6 gap-3">
    <!-- Repeating Gallery Slot Item -->
    <div class="group relative aspect-square rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/40 hover:bg-muted/70 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-4 cursor-pointer transition-all hover:border-primary/50 hover:shadow-sm">
      <svg class="w-10 h-10 text-muted-foreground/50 group-hover:text-primary transition-colors" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5">
        <rect x="3" y="3" width="14" height="14" rx="2"/>
        <circle cx="7.5" cy="7.5" r="1.5"/>
        <path d="M17 13l-4-4-7 7"/>
        <rect x="7" y="7" width="14" height="14" rx="2" stroke-opacity="0.5"/>
        <path d="M21 17l-4-4-3 3" stroke-opacity="0.5"/>
      </svg>
      <span class="mt-2 text-[10px] font-medium text-muted-foreground/70 group-hover:text-foreground">Slot 1</span>
    </div>
    <!-- Repeat for slots 2..6 -->
  </div>
</div>

Go DSL Usage

import "github.com/hyperlibs/HTMX PRO/go/components"

// Server-rendered 6-Slot Gallery
gallery := components.Gallery(components.GalleryProps{
    Columns: 6,
    Slots:   6,
    Dashed:  true,
})
